body.text: Selections sink schedules. A remodel can carry thirty to a hundred client picks — tile, fixtures, paint, hardware — and they usually live in spreadsheets and text threads. When a pick is late, the schedule slips and you eat the rush cost.

SelectSheet gives every project one sheet, organized by room. Each selection gets an allowance, a vendor or link, a due date tied to your project milestones, and an approval status. The allowance ledger tracks over and under on every approved pick, so a $200 overage on plumbing fixtures cannot hide until the final invoice.

items: Remodelers and design-build shops running 2–8 projects
Kitchen and bath contractors drowning in client picks
Anyone still chasing selections over text threads
Shops too small for the $99+/mo suite modules
Add a room, then a line for every selection
Set the allowance, vendor, and due date
Move the status as the client decides: pending, picking, approved
Print the sheet for the job file or save it as a PDF

body.text: SelectSheet is $12 a month, or $60 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
